name: Clifton Poth

affiliations.role: First author of the Adapters library paper; co-developer of AdapterHub

bio: Clifton Poth is a machine learning engineer at Cohere who works on multilingual retrieval and reranking. Poth was first author of the 2023 Adapters library paper and earlier co-developed AdapterHub as a research assistant at the UKP Lab at TU Darmstadt.
known_for: First author of the Adapters library paper
